findings.evidence: `ModuleChains/Basic.lean:250-254` defines `singularHomologyMap` as `(HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((singularChains k).map (TopCat.ofHom g)) n).hom`. The precedent at `LocalHomology/Degree.lean:464` comments on the same defeq ('is by definition the map of the homology functor') before using it.
findings.fix: Add an explicit lemma relating `ContinuousMap.singularHomologyMap R m f.hom` to `((singularHomologyFunctor (ModuleCat R) m).obj (ModuleCat.of R R)).map f` and rewrite with it. Failing that, use a `change` with a comment explaining the defeq, as `LocalHomology/Degree.lean:464-467` does.
findings.issue: `hι` closes `Function.Bijective (ContinuousMap.singularHomologyMap R m (p.fiberι _).hom)` by `exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((singularHomologyFunctor ..).obj ..).map (p.fiberι _)`. This only works because two things unfold to the same term: the `singularHomologyMap` abbrev (`homologyMap ((singularChains k).map (TopCat.ofHom g))`) and `(singularHomologyFunctor ..).obj .. |>.map`, together with `TopCat.ofHom f.hom = f`. None of this is documented.

findings.evidence: `ModuleChains/Basic.lean:266` only provides the pointwise `singularHomologyMap_comp`. The diff writes the funext/rw block at Evaluation.lean:98-102 and PointedMap.lean (`hcomp`), and repeats the injectivity-of-composite unfolding at the end of DoubleLoop.lean.
findings.fix: Add `ContinuousMap.coe_singularHomologyMap_comp : ⇑(singularHomologyMap k n (g.comp g')) = singularHomologyMap k n g ∘ singularHomologyMap k n g'` next to `singularHomologyMap_comp` in `ModuleChains/Basic.lean`. Then each of the three sites becomes `rw [coe_singularHomologyMap_comp]; exact hι.comp …` or `hmap.comp (hincl.1)`.
findings.issue: The step that rewrites `⇑(singularHomologyMap (g.comp g'))` as a function composite takes a funext plus a `singularHomologyMap_comp` rewrite. It is written out by hand in three places: `hcomp'` here, `hcomp` in `exists_homotopicRel_comp_id_of_surjective_singularHomologyMap` (PointedMap.lean), and the `intro a b hab; rw [singularHomologyMap_comp, singularHomologyMap_comp] at hab` in `injective_singularHomologyMap_inclEvalPreimage_comp_map` (DoubleLoop.lean).

summary: In `bijective_singularHomologyMap_inclEvalPreimage`, the step that turns the categorical `IsIso` into bijectivity of `ContinuousMap.singularHomologyMap` relies on the two being definitionally equal, with no comment saying so. The new code also repeats a 'homology map of a composite is the composite of homology maps' rewrite that could be one lemma.
